reasoning: Shows two counterclockwise sync arrows combined with a settings cog at the bottom right. It fits technical tasks around configuring synchronization, automating recurring jobs, or managing system/firmware updates, though casual users must take care not to apply it to generic 'update' tasks (like updating a document) or human 'sync' meetings.
